BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.

2. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.

   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

8. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

9. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

10. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Floor Finishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Ceilings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fixings and Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-cast Concrete Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
